The selloff in the US bond market deepened on Monday after President Donald Trump rejected Iran’s latest proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, dampening hopes of a diplomatic breakthrough to end the war. Patrick Murphy, Executive Director at Hilco Global Geopolitical Unit, former Acting Secretary of the Army & US Congressman

Ed Ludlow, 'Bloomberg Tech' Host (Source: Bloomberg)
